stationAlerts.name: Batley car park - Summer 2026
stationAlerts.alertText:
From Monday 22 September 2025, the car park at Batley station will be closed due to Transpennine route upgrade works taking place.

Pedestrian access and a reduced number of accessible parking spaces (for badge holders only) will be maintained. Alternative car parking can be found at the Kirklees Council car park on Station Road, a short distance (100m) from the Batley station.

Additionally, from Tuesday 19 May to Friday 31 July, the ticket vending machine will be temporarily unavailable at Batley station. Customers should purchase a ticket for their journey at the earliest opportunity. Tickets are available online at northernrailway.co.uk, using the Northern app, or from a ticket office or ticket vending machine at the destination or interchange station.

When you contact us, we kindly ask you to provide the following details:

  • A description of the lost item
  • The service during which you lost it (including the train's departure time, as well as your origin and destination stations)
  • If possible, please specify your location on the train (which carriage)

• Category B Station

To Manchester from Bramhall Lane South, up 28 steps onto the platform. Or, up 6 steps, along a ramp (42 paces, 1:10 slope) onto the platform. Or, from the ramp leading to the former library entrance to a connecting path at the head of the steps, up a ramp (32 paces, 1:10 slope) onto the platform. To Macclesfield : From the junction of Hartington Road and Bramhall Lane South, up 14 steps onto the platform. Or, up a ramp (50 paces, 1:10 slope) onto the platform. This station is not recommended for the severely mobility impaired due to the low height of the platform causing a high step onto the train.

From June 2026 until the end of March 2027, improvement works as part of the Access for All Scheme are taking place at Bryn station. Whilst work takes place, access to the platforms will change:

Both of the above are now being implemented and there is no step-free access at Bryan until works complete in March.

If you require step free access, please contact Northern's Assisted Travel Support Team on 0800 138 5560 or on WhatsApp on 07779 914800.

stepFreeCategory.category: A, Compliant step-free access to all platform(s)
stepFreeCategory.notes:
• Category B Station

Access to the Manchester bound platform is by a series of four ramps. The first two are 25 metres, then 15 metres, then 25 metres with a rest platform between each or, via the first slope and then up two separate flights of steps with 25 steps in total. Access to the Liverpool bound platform is off Hollies Road via three slopes each 50 metes long with rest platforms or, by two flights of stairs with 18 steps with intermediate rest platform. Steps begin 25 metres down the ramp and end with a 27 metre ramp.

Northern is committed to making rail travel more accessible and inclusive for everyone.

For customers who arrive on platform 1 (Newcastle bound) and need assistance, please use the call button located at the bottom of the stairs, which alerts the ticket office.

stationAlerts.name: Huncoat footbridge
stationAlerts.alertText:
The footbridge at Huncoat station is temporarily closed whilst repairs are carried out to ensure that the footbridge remains safe and reliable for passengers. During this time you can use the level crossing at the station. When using the crossing, please remember:

  • Stop and wait for the barriers to open
  • Obey all safety signals
  • Look both ways and listen - trains can approach in both directions, at the same time
  • Wait until all trains have left the station before crossing
  • Do not stop on the crossing.

stepFreeCategory.category: B1, (refer to quick reference guide)
stepFreeCategory.notes:
• Category B Station

Step free access at this station, but not entirely obstacle free. Step free access to both platforms via short ramps from separate entrances. Step-free access between platforms is via a pedestrian level crossing with hinged, locking gates (controlled by the signaller in the adjacent Signal Box), or a steep route via the street (300m), in places without a pavement. If you are using the level crossing, please allow sufficient time before your train as the gates are locked shut when trains are arriving, departing and when terminating trains from Leeds are shunting from one platform to the other.

stepFreeCategory.category: B1, (refer to quick reference guide)
stepFreeCategory.notes:
• Category B Station

Level access to platform 1.

There is a footbridge over the tracks which is the only access to the Leeds/Bradford platform 2. However, there is access onto both platforms directly but not between platforms

Mobility impaired passengers travelling towards Leeds/Bradford are requested to travel via Ilkley and change trains there. It should be noted that there is a very large stepping distance onto platform 2 and therefore is unsuitable for mobility scooters due to the risk of tipping over.

New Footbridge/Lifts are due for completion late 2025/early 2026.

stationAlerts.name: Rail replacement - Car park - Mossley
stationAlerts.title: Rail replacement - Mossley
stationAlerts.alertText:
Rail replacement buses pick up / drop off at the bus stops on Manchester Road (A635) near The Britannia Inn.

Part of the car park at Mossley station will be temporarily closed while engineering works are taking place as part of the Transpennine Route Upgrade.

Customers will not be able to access the car park on the following dates:

· Friday 17 July at 22:00 – Monday 20 July at 22:00.

Pedestrian access will remain in place at the station.

Customers are advised to check details of their journey before travelling. Further information is available via information posters at the station or through contacting the Northern customer experience centre telephone number on 0800 200 6060.

There is additional access to the Hadfield platform down a ramp (40 yards) from Danby Road or a footpath from Victoria Street (200 yards) then up one large step and through a gate on to the platform. This gate can also be reached from the approach road, under the railway arch and up 28 steps.

You can also book Passenger Assistance in advance at northernrailway.co.uk/passenger-assist or by calling 0800 138 5560. stationAlerts.name: Whaley Bridge Station Alert
stationAlerts.alertText: From 16 January, Engineering works being undertaken to replace a bridge may affect roads around the station, please check before you travel.  In addition to this, train services on 18-28 February will be replaced by road vehicles.

stepFreeCategory.category: B1, (refer to quick reference guide)
stepFreeCategory.notes:
• Category B Station

The station forecourt/car park slopes steeply upwards from its entrance at the junction of Market street and Reservoir Road. Access to the Buxton platform is step-free via a tarmac footpath along the front of the station building to a gate onto the platform, or via 10 steps up to the ticket office then one step down onto the platform. Step-free access to the Manchester platform is via a sloping path from Station View and through a gate onto the platform. A stepped footbridge connects the two platforms. However there is a large gap between the train and platform on both platforms.

helpline.notes:
Assistance is provided by the conductor at this station, please wait on the platform for the train to arrive.

We can also provide help when you travel, even if it has not been booked in advance. You can turn up at this station if it is accessible to you and request assistance onto a train from a member of staff directly, or by using a help point. Boarding ramps are carried on all of our trains.

We want everyone to travel with confidence. That is why, if you are planning on travelling on national rail services, you can request an assistance booking in advance - now up to 2 hours before your journey is due to start, any time of the day. For more information about Passenger Assist and how to request an assistance booking via Passenger Assist, please click here.
